# resolution-aspect-decision

Purpose: Pick the right render resolution + aspect ratio for the consumer use case before render; avoid render-then-crop and aspect mismatch.

Avoid the most common render planning mistake: rendering at one aspect / resolution and cropping or upscaling to fit. Pick the consumer's required output upfront.

Metadata: Contract `v1.0.0` | Category `render-and-output-decisions` | Role `resolution-and-aspect-ratio-pinner` | Tier `L0` | Runtime default `Not Run` | Artifact default `Not Produced` | Mutation `downgrade_only`

## When to use & trigger cues
- before render
- when consumer requires specific aspect / resolution
- before composition planning (aspect drives composition rules)
- Trigger phrases: "what resolution", "how big should the render be", "16:9 or square"

## When not to use (delegation boundaries)
- after render is complete (no benefit) → use `camera-composition` (`references/skill-camera-composition.md`; no benefit)
- pure modeling → use `output-format-decision` (`references/skill-output-format-decision.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to output-format-decision)
- internal preview-only renders (any reasonable size works) → use `composition-quality-checker` (`references/skill-composition-quality-checker.md`; any reasonable size works)

## Input & output contract
- Required input `target_delivery_surfaces` (`array`): Target display placements (desktop hero banner, mobile portrait feed, 1:1 e-commerce card, 4K print)
- Required input `framing_and_crop_strategy` (`string`): Whether deliverables use a single master aspect ratio with safe-zone crops or separate camera setups
- Optional input `render_time_constraints` (`string`): Optional render time ceiling influencing pixel dimensions and percentage scale
- Output contract: `pinned_pixel_dimensions_and_aspect_ratio`, `safe_frame_and_overscan_margins`, `camera_sensor_fit_alignment_notes` (Runtime status: `Not Run`, Artifact status: `Not Produced`, `downgrade_only`).

## Quick-start steps
1. Identify the consumer use case and target placement (web hero, social feed, print, app asset).
2. Pick the delivery aspect ratio (`W:H`) upfront so camera framing matches target placement.
3. Pick exact render resolution (`W × H` in pixels) and `DPI / PPI` for print deliverables.
4. Define per-stream resolution records if multiple delivery targets exist.
5. Pin the record for the operator to enter in Blender scene render properties (no rendering, no post-render resizing).

## Safety boundaries & non-goals
- Runtime boundary: Decision skill — does not render. Pins resolution + aspect; operator applies in scene render properties.
- Never execute Blender or trigger renders.
- Never resize, crop, upscale, or convert images post-render (belongs outside this skill).
- Never choose file containers, codecs, or bit depths (`output-format-decision`).
- Never configure color spaces or HDR view transforms (`color-management-decision`).
- Never validate camera composition (`composition-quality-checker`) or verify rendered output files (`render-export-evidence`).
